definitions.explanation: Attached to the masu-stem of a verb to mean 'way of doing.' Functions as a suffix in this usage.
A polite way to refer to a person. More respectful than 人.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{読|よ}み{方|かた}→読み方：14269_yomikata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧？
examples.english: How do you read this kanji?

examples.japanese: ⟦{箸|はし}→箸：01026_hashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{持|も}ち{方|かた}→持ち方：28218_mochikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please teach me how to hold chopsticks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作|つく}り{方|かた}→作り方：27938_tsukurikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{習|なら}った→習う：00479_narau⟧。
examples.english: I learned how to cook from my mother.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの{方|かた}→あの方：16618_anokata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どなた→どなた：02923_donata⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
お⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧さま⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、お⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧さま⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{方|かた}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いらっしゃいます→いらっしゃる：01295_irassharu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Is there a doctor among the passengers?

examples.japanese: ⟦こちら→こちら：00960_kochira⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{方|かた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{田中|たなか}→田中：09528_tanaka⟧さんです。
examples.english: This is Mr. Tanaka, the person in charge.

notes:
SENSE 1 — WAY OF DOING:
Attaches to the masu-stem of verbs: {verb stem}+{方|かた}.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{読|よ}み{方|かた}→読み方：14269_yomikata⟧: way of reading
- ⟦{書|か}き{方|かた}→書き方：13054_kakikata⟧: way of writing
- ⟦{使|つか}い{方|かた}→使い方：07797_tsukaikata⟧: way of using
- ⟦{食|た}べ{方|かた}→食べ方：27437_tabekata⟧: way of eating
- ⟦{考|かんが}え{方|かた}→考え方：10169_kangaekata⟧: way of thinking

SENSE 2 — PERSON (POLITE):
More polite than ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧. Used in formal speech and polite conversation. Often preceded by ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧, ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧, ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧, or ⟦どの→どの：00551_dono⟧.

NOTE: {方|かた} (person) is distinct from ⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧ (direction/alternative), which is a separate word with the same kanji.
